title: Show HN: CheapSecurity – Lightweight, Self-Hosted CCTV for Linux SBCs
summary: CheapSecurity is a lightweight, self-hosted CCTV solution designed to run on affordable Linux Single Board Computers like Raspberry Pi, offering a privacy-focused alternative to cloud-based security camera systems.
problem_solved: Provides an affordable and privacy-respecting video surveillance system that runs locally without requiring expensive cloud subscriptions or proprietary hardware.
why_valuable: It democratizes home/business security by enabling users to build their own CCTV system for under $50 using readily available hardware, with full data ownership and no recurring fees.
